name: talk-light
steps: (async()=>{await document.fonts.ready;for(let i=0;i<200;i++){if(document.querySelector('.talk-log__list'))return;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));}throw Error('Talk did not load')})()
if (!document.querySelector('.safety-rail .named-stop__button')?.textContent.includes(document.querySelector('.talk-bar__title-text').textContent)) throw Error('Stop targets another task')

name: desktop-leave
steps: (async()=>{await document.fonts.ready;for(let i=0;i<200;i++){if(document.querySelector('.talk-log__list'))return;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));}throw Error('Talk did not load')})()

name: computer-use
steps: (async()=>{await document.fonts.ready;for(let i=0;i<200;i++){if(document.querySelector('.talk-log__list'))return;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));}throw Error('Talk did not load')})()

const nav=document.querySelector('.nav').getBoundingClientRect();for(const b of document.querySelectorAll('.agent-screen .control-footer button')){const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.width<48||r.height<48||nav.top-r.bottom<8)throw Error('Unsafe touch area');const hit=document.elementFromPoint(r.x+r.width/2,nav.top+2);if(hit?.closest('.control-footer'))throw Error('Tab tap hits safety control')}
